steps.title: Two targets at once
steps.body: A knight jumps, so pieces cannot block it, and it attacks from an unexpected square. When it lands on a square that attacks two valuable pieces, one of them falls.

wrong.default: Find the square where the knight attacks the king and the rook.

steps.onSuccess: The knight attacked king and rook, so it won the rook.

wrong.default: Look for a knight move that gives check and attacks the rook.

steps.onSuccess: Nc7+ forked the king and the rook on a8.

steps.q: Why is the knight good at forks?
options: It moves in a straight line
